request_map.request: Compare recent clicks per eligible day for course peers.
Compare recent clicks per eligible day for same prior attempt peers.
Compare recent clicks per eligible day for early stage peers.

limitations: Recorded clicks are not effort, ability, learning or study time; logging completeness is unknown.
Registration approximates opportunity, not actual exposure. The withdrawal day is the first ineligible day.
Assessment scores and banked credit are withheld: grade-release and banking-approval times are unknown.
Scheduled assessments are opportunities, not verified individual obligations; exemptions may be unobserved.
Source interaction rows can repeat; sums preserve all source rows and are not verified unique click events.
Peer means describe eligible observed person-weeks; changing eligibility and informative withdrawal can change composition.
Exploratory development analysis only; no causal, significance, anomaly or prediction claim.
All task focal people are excluded from the fixed development reference pool.
Earlier-stage peers answer a different descriptive question; they are not a causal or automatically fairer adjustment.
result.reference_label: BBB_2013B: Other development people in this presentation, excluding all task focal people; reference weeks 8–11

uncertainty.label: 95% bootstrap interval for peer mean; not individual prediction uncertainty
uncertainty.resampling_unit: person with within-window history kept together
uncertainty.scope: Pointwise descriptive intervals; no interval for a focal contrast, personal change or reference difference
